---
name: sandbox-js-and-browser-testing
description: How to run JavaScript and browser-test a page on this machine's sandbox (no node, no Chrome, Firefox hangs)
metadata:
  type: reference
---

Environment facts found on 2026-11-24 in the pcd-sbx sandbox on this Mac (Apple M4, macOS 27):

- `node` is not installed. A working V8/Node 24 runtime: `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 /Applications/ZCode.app/Contents/MacOS/ZCode script.js` (worker_threads and `--cpu-prof` work). `jsc` also exists under JavaScriptCore.framework/Versions/A/Helpers/.
- Do not launch `/Applications/Claude.app` this way (it fails sandbox init and spews errors).
- No Chrome. Headless Firefox hangs at startup inside the sandbox (blocked in AuthorizationCopyRights), so it cannot be used.
- Browser testing that does work: compile a small Swift driver with `swiftc` that hosts an offscreen `WKWebView` (WebGL2 works). Needed settings: `WKWebsiteDataStore.nonPersistent()`, `wv.setValue(false, forKey: "windowOcclusionDetectionEnabled")` so requestAnimationFrame runs at 60 Hz offscreen, `mediaTypesRequiringUserActionForPlayback = []` to let AudioContext run, borderless window positioned off-screen. Drive with `evaluateJavaScript` and `takeSnapshot`.
- Shell heredocs fail in this sandbox ("can't create temp file for here document"); write files with the Write tool or `python3 -c`. Backticks inside double-quoted `python3 -c "..."` strings are executed by zsh.
- Scratch files belong in `$TMPDIR` (the sandbox `tmp/` dir), not in the working directory.

`./index.html` is written and is the only file in the working directory. It could not be tested in Chrome (none is installed here), so the browser checks below were done in WebKit.

## Self-check vectors
- **Vector A** matched: score 25.38, fallTick 1035, 166 entries, hash `82a5353d`.
- **Vector B** matched: score 10.93, fallTick 457, 48 entries, hash `2e8858d7`.
- The page re-runs both at load and sets `BENCH_REPORT.selfCheck` from the result (both `true`).
- The spec text says the air lane is 2600 long, but only the polyline's actual length of 2800 reproduces the hashes, so the sim uses 2800.

## Strategy
- **Design:** the strategy carries its own exact copy of the rules and plays a shadow game alongside the engine, so it can simulate ahead before spending.
  - It buys just in time: it only spends when a 320-tick look-ahead shows a leak that waiting one more wave would not fix, banking about 1000 gold for interest until wave 22.
  - Gold above the bank goes to whichever build, upgrade, type swap or rebuild of a reloading cannon/lance gives the best 480-tick look-ahead gain per gold.
  - Targeting is decided in the shadow game (menders first, cannons and flak aimed at the most valuable splash) and replayed through `target()`.
- **Measured score:** mean **47.24** waves on 200 seeds not used for tuning (min 43.28, max 49.53). Other seed ranges (0–30, large 32-bit values, the tuning sets) all landed between 46.9 and 47.6. For comparison, the all-bolt strategy from vector A scores about 25.
- **Seed 42:** 48.63 waves, fall at tick 1965 (98.25 s into the replay).
- **CPU:** about 0.6–0.7 s per full game on this Apple M4, with a deterministic work cap that switches to a cheap rule well before the 10 s limit.
- **Robustness:** the shadow never disagreed with the engine in any test game. Against a deliberately altered engine it resynced from the public state and still scored about 45; malformed input never made it throw.

## Implemented
Board, enemies and turrets, combat visuals, fall, HUD and audio are all implemented and reported as "full". Deliberate simplifications, also listed in `BENCH_REPORT`:
- Enemies are drawn with a small sideways offset so stacked enemies stay readable.
- Debris comes to rest where it lands, without bouncing.
- Cannon shells fly for the first half of the 0.15 s effect and burst in the second half.

## Verified versus assumed
- **Verified in an offscreen WebKit view (the Safari engine):**
  - The page loads with no errors.
  - The countdown, pause/play, speed pills, scrubbing, Re-fire hold and end state behave as specified.
  - Rendered pixels are identical at the same `simTime` whether reached forwards, backwards or after Re-fire.
  - The dock measures 536×44 px, 24 px from the bottom.
  - Playback held 60 fps at 1920×1080 through the heaviest stretch.
  - The audio code ran through waves, leaks and the fall without errors, including the 12-shots-per-second cap and silence outside playback.
- **Not verified:**
  - Behaviour in Chrome specifically.
  - How the audio actually sounds — I never listened to it.
  - Frame rate on a mid-range GPU; `measuredFps: 60` comes from the M4 run above.
- **Assumed:** upgrading a turret does not reset its cooldown. The spec doesn't say, and neither vector exercises it.
